name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control.
cue: Push heels down, lift the hips
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
